name: FormatConditions
description: Represents the collection of conditional formats for a single range.
remarks: The FormatConditions collection can contain multiple conditional formats. Each format is represented by a FormatCondition object. Use the FormatConditions property to return a FormatConditions object. Use the Add method to create a new conditional format, and use the Modify method of the FormatCondition object to change an existing conditional format.
example:
With Worksheets(1).Range("e1:e10").FormatConditions _
 .Add(xlCellValue, xlGreater, "=$a$1")
 With .Borders
 .LineStyle = xlContinuous
 .Weight = xlThin
 .ColorIndex = 6
 End With
 With .Font
 .Bold = True
 .ColorIndex = 3
 End With
End With

properties.name: Application
properties.description: When used without an object qualifier, this property returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Excel application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which this object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object. Read-only.

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Returns a Long value that represents the number of objects in the collection.

methods.name: Item
methods.description: Returns a single object from a collection.

parameters.name: Index
parameters.description: The name or index number for the object.

methods.name: Add
methods.signature: Add(Type As XlFormatConditionType, [Operator As Variant], [Formula1 As Variant], [Formula2 As Variant], [String As Variant], [TextOperator As Variant], [DateOperator As Variant], [ScopeType As Variant]) As Object

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description: Specifies whether the conditional format is based on a cell value or an expression.

parameters.name: Operator
parameters.description: The conditional format operator. Can be one of the following XlFormatConditionOperator constants: xlBetween, xlEqual, xlGreater, xlGreaterEqual, xlLess, xlLessEqual, xlNotBetween, or xlNotEqual. If _Type_ is xlExpression, the _Operator_ argument is ignored.

parameters.name: Formula1
parameters.description: The value or expression associated with the conditional format. Can be a constant value, a string value, a cell reference, or a formula.

parameters.name: Formula2
parameters.description: The value or expression associated with the second part of the conditional format when _Operator_ is xlBetween or xlNotBetween (otherwise, this argument is ignored). Can be a constant value, a string value, a cell reference, or a formula.

methods.name: AddColorScale
methods.description: Returns a new ColorScale object representing a conditional formatting rule that uses gradations in cell colors to indicate relative differences in the values of cells included in a selected range.

methods.name: AddDatabar
methods.description: Returns a Databar object representing a data bar conditional formatting rule for the specified range.

methods.name: AddIconSetCondition
methods.description: Returns a new IconSetCondition object that represents an icon set conditional formatting rule for the specified range.

methods.name: AddTop10
methods.description: Returns a Top10 object representing a conditional formatting rule for the specified range.

methods.name: AddAboveAverage
methods.description: Returns a new AboveAverage object representing a conditional formatting rule for the specified range.

methods.name: AddUniqueValues
methods.description: Returns a new UniqueValues object representing a conditional formatting rule for the specified range.
